probes.What is a toothbrush?: A **toothbrush** is a tool used for cleaning and removing dental plaque and food particles from the surfaces of your teeth. It is typically a small, handheld instrument with a sharp edge or a textured surface designed to scrape off plaque. Toothbrushes are commonly used in conjunction with a dental pick or a dental mirror to access hard-to-reach areas of the mouth. They are an essential part of oral hygiene and are used by dental professionals to maintain the health of the gums and teeth.
